description: Building designs whose furnished interiors were reviewed as pairs of shell and interior. An automatic interior pick opens only a building standing in one of these; a building asked for by id opens whatever it stands in. The plain generator building and the designs Exterior added after the review (industrial-framed, service-storage, paired-rounded, paired-rectangular, rounded-corner, chamfered-corners, terrace-blocks) were never reviewed with an interior.

designs.balcony-grid: Four-copy review world: one 20.5 x 37.5 m, 7-floor tower at four quarter turns, then the seven-family gallery; Interior 0.35.0 pairs it and tests stair joins across its assembled floors.
designs.corporate-sectors: Seven-family gallery at 40 x 40 m, 12 floors; Interior 0.35.0 pairs it with its charcoal panels.
designs.faceted-bays: Seven-family gallery at 32 x 24 m, 8 floors; Interior 0.35.0 pairs it.
designs.mirror-frame: Seven-family gallery at 32 x 24 m, 8 floors; Interior 0.35.0 pairs it with its graphite panels.
designs.mirror-shutters: Seven-family gallery at 32 x 24 m, 8 floors; Interior 0.35.0 pairs it with its charcoal panels.
designs.white-grid: Seven-family gallery at 32 x 24 m, 8 floors; Interior 0.35.0 pairs it and climbs its 5 m podium in two 14-riser flights.
designs.garden-taper: Seven-family gallery landmark at 52 x 42 m, 4 floors; Interior 0.35.0 pairs it and gives each tapered floor its own layout.
